$comment: Golden NCR trips for phase-1 acceptance (spec §3 criterion 3). Every trip was re-probed on 2026-11-01 against the live 494-route feed WITH the BFF plausibility guard active (MAX_TRANSIT_SPEED_KMH = 120 km/h in services/api/src/routing/map-itinerary.ts), and every count/mode/fare below is what the stack actually returned at the pinned departure. `minItineraries` is 3 for every trip per the criterion and is never lowered. `requiredModes` must appear in the union of the trip's itineraries, not in every itinerary. `fareBounds` are the live observed min/max rounded outward; they catch a broken fare engine without pinning exact prices. Corridors whose options are all built on impossible R10 geometry (e.g. the uv-m01 shape claiming 60 km in 2 minutes) are excluded and documented in docs/runbooks/phase1-acceptance.md with their data reason instead of being admitted by lowering a bound.

trips.name: Cubao to Ayala
trips.note: MRT-3 corridor; live run returned 4 MRT-3 itineraries at PHP 10.50. Six provincial through-bus options (bus-cubaobalayan / bus-59 / bus-61) were dropped by the plausibility guard: their shapes claim 40-70 km in 2-4 minutes.

trips.name: Marikina to Cubao
trips.note: LRT-2 corridor; live run returned 12 itineraries (17.16 / 23.00 / 28.20), no implausible legs dropped.

trips.name: Cubao to Manila
trips.note: LRT-2 into Manila; live run returned 11 itineraries (24.00 / 25.93 / 26.90); 3 impossible options dropped.

trips.name: Pasay to Monumento
trips.note: LRT-1 corridor; live run returned 8 itineraries (47.16 / 51.22), no implausible legs dropped.

trips.name: Cubao to Pasig
trips.note: Pasig River Ferry corridor; live run returned 4 walk+bus+ferry itineraries at PHP 27.44; 4 impossible options dropped.

trips.name: Pasay to Taguig
trips.note: Ferry + jeepney corridor; live run returned 12 itineraries (61.29 / 84.52 / 89.37); 12 impossible options dropped.

trips.name: Fairview to Manila
trips.note: Replaces the brief-era Fairview->Makati corridor, whose every option rode the defective uv-m01 shape (60,837 m in 2 min). Live run returned 10 bus itineraries (61.19 / 79.16); 15 impossible options dropped. The brief's jeepney+bus expectation never held on this data: before the guard the live set was bus + UV Express + MRT-3 + walk, i.e. only jeepney was absent.

trips.name: Novaliches to Cubao
trips.note: Replaces Novaliches->Ortigas, whose options all rode a 24,581 m jeepney leg in 2 minutes. Live run returned 4 bus itineraries at PHP 104.46, no implausible legs dropped.

trips.name: Las Pinas to Makati
trips.note: South corridor; after the guard only the bus options are physically possible, so the required mode is bus (live run: 4 itineraries at PHP 69.95; 15 impossible LRT-1/UV/bus combinations dropped).

trips.name: Cubao to Divisoria
trips.note: Short heavy city bus corridor; live run returned 4 bus itineraries at PHP 51.92, no implausible legs dropped.
